title: Reserve Airmen saves lives as part of Hurricane Harvey relief effort (547369)
description: Members of the 920th Rescue Wing prepare to rescue a Hurricane Harvey victim Aug. 31, 2017 from an HH-60 Pave Hawk helicopter near Beaumont, Texas. The 920th RQW deployed roughly 90 people, three HH-60 Pave Hawks and two HC-130Ns to College Station, Texas to support Air Force North's search and rescue mission for FEMA disaster relief. (U.S. Air Force video/Tech. Sgt. Lindsey Maurice)
